title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1981-05-02
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:30152) Recording Info: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M) -> Reel (Technics 1/2 Track 7.5 Inch) -> Dat; Transfer Info: Dat (Fostex D5) -> Audiophile 2496 -> Samplitude v7.02 Professional -> FLAC,Transferred By Joe Samaritano,Patched and Edited By Charlie Miller; Audience (shnid:134759)Sennheiser MD421 Dynamic Cardioid Microphones-TC D5 Cassette Recorder, Location: Soundboard,Analog to Digital: Dolby B Decoded Cassette Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Korg MR-1000(DSF[1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo])Korg AudioGate-WAV[24/96],Recording,Editing & Processing by Jim Wise,Transfer by David Minches

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures an early‑80s show with a strong setlist highlighted by Sugaree, though Jerry’s playing wanes on Terrapin.
ai_review.review: The matrix mix is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard instrument clarity and balanced levels that let every note from Bob, Phil and Jerry shine. Musically the concert is generally lauded – a great early‑80s setlist with standout moments like Sugaree – but one reviewer notes that Jerry’s playing becomes unfocused during Terrapin Station in the second set.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and extol both the superb matrix sound quality and the overall strength of the performance, with only a single moderate critique lowering the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly describe the mix as "excellent", noting superb soundboard instrument clarity, balanced keyboards/vocals, and an overall crisp, immersive listening experience that blends SBD and AUD sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set list is regarded as strong for the era with a great early‑80s vibe, though the second set suffers when Jerry appears unfocused on Terrapin Station.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for clear presence in the mix, but criticized for being "too stoned" and uneven during Terrapin Station.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted positively – his bass lines come through clearly in the matrix.
band_member_comments.Bob: His guitar work is audible and well‑defined according to reviewers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards are praised for tasteful balance; reviewers like the pre‑mid lineup sound.
